user.title: Garmin Connect Personal API
user.description: Create a key in [Garmin Connect]({key_url}) and paste it here. Garmin shows it only once.

data_description.name: Display name of the account, e.g. a first name. It becomes the device name and part of every entity ID (for example sensor.jan_steps if the name is Jan); renaming later does not change existing entity IDs.
data_description.api_key: The key from Garmin Connect (Settings > Personal API key). Garmin shows it only once.
data_description.key_validity_days: The same duration you chose in Garmin when creating the key. Garmin does not report the expiry date; it is calculated from this value and only used for the reminder before expiry.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {account} no longer works (expected to expire on {expires}). Create a new key in the same Garmin account in [Garmin Connect]({key_url}) and enter it.

data_description.api_key: The new key from Garmin Connect, created in the same Garmin account.
data_description.key_validity_days: The duration you chose in Garmin for the new key (preset: your last choice). The expiry date is calculated from it.

reconfigure.title: Replace API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new key for {account} (expected to expire on {expires}). Create it in the same Garmin account in [Garmin Connect]({key_url}).

data_description.api_key: The new key from Garmin Connect, created in the same Garmin account.
data_description.key_validity_days: The duration you chose in Garmin for the new key (preset: your last choice). The expiry date is calculated from it.

error.invalid_auth: The key was rejected by Garmin.
error.account_id_missing: Garmin did not return an account ID, so the account cannot be identified.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This key belongs to a different Garmin account than this entry. Create the key in the same Garmin account.

data.hourly_statistics: Write hourly statistics (heart rate, Body Battery, SpO2)
data.sync_stale_hours: Warn when the watch has not synced for (hours)

data_description.daily_interval_minutes: How often the daily values are requested. The other data is fetched only after a new watch sync or less often.
data_description.intraday_attributes: Adds heart rate, Body Battery and SpO2 series to the sensors as attributes. This makes the state data large, requests extra data from Garmin and the series are not stored in the recorder.
data_description.hourly_statistics: After each new watch sync, writes heart rate, Body Battery and SpO2 as hourly values (minimum, maximum, mean of each completed hour) into the long-term statistics. Independent of the option above; costs one extra request per series and sync (plus one per series for yesterday in the morning).
data_description.history_auto: After each new watch sync, appends the new measuring points of heart rate, Body Battery, SpO2 and HRV as recorded states of their (history) sensors, and fills in the past days up to the recorder's keep days (at most 400), slowly in the background. Only for history sensors that you enabled and that the recorder records. Adds one state per measuring point to the database (about 720 per day for heart rate) until purge_keep_days removes it.
data_description.sync_stale_hours: The binary sensor reports a problem when the last watch sync is older than this many hours.

key_expiring.title: Garmin API key for {account} expires soon
key_expiring.description: The API key for {account} is expected to expire on {expires} ({days_left} days left). Garmin does not report the expiry date; it is calculated from your entry during setup. Create a new key in Garmin Connect in time and enter it via Reconfigure.

key_expired.title: Garmin API key for {account} has expired
key_expired.description: According to your entry the API key for {account} expired on {expires}. Create a new key in Garmin Connect and enter it via Reconfigure.

history_not_recorded.title: A history sensor is not recorded
history_not_recorded.description: The history sensor for {series} of {account} is enabled, but the recorder excludes it (include/exclude settings), so nothing is written to the history. Allow the entity in the recorder settings or disable the sensor.

fetch.name: Fetch data
fetch.description: Fetch any Garmin endpoint for a day or range and return the raw result.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

filters.name: Filters
filters.description: Activity filters as a mapping, e.g. activity_type: running, min_distance: 10000, favorite: false.

chunks.name: Body Battery intervals (chunks)
chunks.description: Only for endpoint body_battery: raw Garmin parameter chunks, the number of time intervals each day is divided into (Garmin returns the lowest and highest reading of each). Left out, the request is the one the sensors send. For reading tests.

full_history_scan.name: Scan full history (fitness age)
full_history_scan.description: Only for endpoint fitness_age: raw Garmin parameter fullHistoryScan. Off (default, as the sensors send it), Garmin only looks at the last 28 days before the date. For reading tests.

include_all.name: Include all weigh-ins
include_all.description: Only for endpoint weight_range: raw Garmin parameter includeAll. On (default, as the sensors send it) returns every weigh-in of a day, off only the latest. For reading tests.

search_activities.name: Search activities
search_activities.description: Search activities with filters; pages automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

filters.name: Filters
filters.description: Filters as a mapping, for example activity_type, min_distance, start_date, favorite.

download_activity.name: Download activity file
download_activity.description: Saves the original activity files (ZIP) to an allowed folder.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

path.name: Target file
path.description: Target .zip file or a folder. Default: folder garmin_personal in the media folder, file activity_ID.zip. The folder must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs (media folders are).

backfill_statistics.name: Import daily values as statistics
backfill_statistics.description: Writes daily values (activity, sleep, HRV, weight) into long-term statistics (external, one value per day). Safe to repeat. Runs in 31-day windows; the response says whether it completed (complete, last_completed_day, error) and how many days and rows were written (days_imported, statistic_series, statistic_rows).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Default: days back from the end date.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to import. Default: yesterday; today only if given explicitly (an incomplete day).

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days back from the end date (at most 3650). Used when no start date is given.

include_third_party_steps.name: Steps from other apps
include_third_party_steps.description: Also import steps, distance and floors of days that other apps (e.g. RunGap) wrote into Garmin Connect. Calories and heart rate of those days are never imported.

backfill_intraday.name: Import hourly values as statistics
backfill_intraday.description: Writes the day curves of heart rate, Body Battery and SpO2 as hourly values (minimum, maximum, mean of each completed hour) into long-term statistics. One request per day and series; a range may span at most 366 days. Safe to repeat: the same hours are overwritten. The response says whether it completed (complete, last_completed_day, error) and how many hours were written per series.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Default: days back from the end date.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to import. Default: today (only completed hours are written, never the running hour).

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days back from the end date (at most 366, default 7). Used when no start date is given.

backfill_history.name: Write history sensors (appending only)
backfill_history.description: Writes the real measuring points of heart rate, Body Battery, SpO2 and the night's HRV with their own timestamps as recorded states of the (history) sensors, so the History panel shows them. Appends only: points already written are never written again, overwritten or deleted. The sensors must be enabled and recorded. This also runs automatically (option Fill in history automatically); use the service for a specific range.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Garmin account. May be left out only if exactly one account is set up.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Default: days back from the end date.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days back from the end date (at most 31, default 1).

series.name: Series
series.description: Any of heart_rate, body_battery, spo2, hrv (default: all).

confirm_rewrite.name: Write without check
confirm_rewrite.description: Only if the record of written points is lost and the recorder cannot be checked: write the requested days anyway. This can duplicate states that exist already.
